note: Unofficial fan guide. Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list; every guide below is written in our own words and cites its sources. Five methods are marked UNCONFIRMED where no published guide has yet pinned the method down.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap: story first, then heists and duo work, then the open-world grind, and finally the cleanup sweep that takes you to 100 percent.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it through to its end. It is the first story mission, so you cannot miss it: just follow the on-screen prompts and finish the job.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in this guide that cannot wait: meditate at the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude, the only missable trophy on the list.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Chapter trophies are automatic: keep playing the gold story markers and this one pops when the chapter closes.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. By now the map has opened up, but do not get pulled into the grind yet: the story chapters are the spine of the roadmap, and the side content is easier once you have the full map and gear.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. You are deep into the story now; keep pushing the main missions and this pops at the chapter's end.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the gold trophy for beating the game, and it unlocks the post-game cleanup: after the credits, the whole map stays open, so anything you skipped can be mopped up in stage 4.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to the end. It is a named mission on the story path, so it comes to you as you work through the chapters.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story heist mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set pieces of the story: follow the setup steps the game gives you, then finish the heist itself.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play through to its end. Another named mission on the story path; no special preparation is needed.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Keep following the gold story markers and this pops when the mission wraps up.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. The name gives the setting away: expect a takedown job around VCIA, and finish it to earn the trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story named mission, so it arrives naturally as you work through the chapters; finish it and the trophy is yours.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion on the in-game stats screen. This is the second gold and the real endgame: it counts story, stranger missions, collectibles, activities and exploration together. Use the tracker in this guide to work through the list, and check the stats screen often so nothing is left at 99 percent.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total: jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like, all counted together. Do not grind this in one sitting; it builds up on its own while you drive around Leonida doing everything else, and you can top it off late in stage 3 by chaining jumps off ramps and hills. PSN tracks the count toward 250.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 250 stunts)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, hunting, meditation and the rest of the open-world pastimes. One go at each is enough, so work down the list early in stage 3 and tick them off in the tracker as you try them.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a pure skill grind: visit the range, learn each challenge's target pattern, and replay the ones you miss until every one shows gold. Bring your best aim and patience; there is no shortcut, just 42 golds. PSN tracks the count toward 42.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 42 challenges)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course, so fly each one until you take first place. Learn the racing line on your first run, then push for the win on the second; the tracker lets you tick off locations as you clear them.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 14 locations)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Variety is what counts, so do not replay the same race: work through the race list, one win per event, and keep count in the tracker. Faster cars and clean lines matter more than aggression.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots, take the challenge, and out-fish him: steady reeling, no slack on the line, and patience when the fish runs. One win is all it takes.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it to its end. Any game counts, so choose the one you are best at.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Stranger and contact missions appear as you explore, so keep an eye out for Andy's marker and work through his jobs in order until the strand closes.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by completing his final mission. The name hints at boats, so expect his jobs to take you out on the water; work through them in order until the last one is done.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Like the other contact strands, his jobs unlock one after another, so follow his marker whenever it appears and close out the strand.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers show up as question-mark encounters on the map; each one is a short chain of jobs. Do eight chains end to end. The contact strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone count toward this, so by the time you finish those you are most of the way there.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Zone — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Work through his jobs in order whenever his marker appears, and the strand closes with this trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by completing his final mission. Follow his jobs in order until the last one is done; the strand ends with this trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. MISSABLE: one of the 18 spots is in Chapter 1 and vanishes once Chapter 1 ends, so meditate there before you finish the chapter. After that, the remaining spots stay available for the rest of the game, so sweep them up in stage 3 and use the tracker to tick each spot off. Do this one first, before anything else on the list.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 18 spots)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Find Bret, take the hunt, and track the animal down in the wilds of Leonida: move slowly, watch the wind and your noise, and take the shot when you have a clean one. One successful hunt earns the trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, in shops, stashes and out-of-the-way corners; pick them up as you explore and trade or buy the ones you are missing until three sets are complete. This is a stage 4 cleanup job: do it last, when you can sweep the map freely.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Zone — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo-and-tag activity: find the marked spots around Leonida, snap them, and move on. One hundred sounds like a lot, but it adds up fast once you start sweeping the map in stage 4; the tracker helps you keep count toward 100.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 100 locations)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total. Challenges are the small goals layered over everything you do: driving, shooting, flying, exploring. They tick over on their own while you chase the rest of the list, and you can finish the last few deliberately in stage 3 by picking the easiest open ones.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The trick is to get the heat first, then break line of sight: duck into alleys, swap cars, and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. Do it with your partner in the car or on foot beside you.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without ever losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three close shops, hit each one quickly, and keep moving: the wanted level must stay live the whole time, so do not let the cops drop off between robberies.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new car, bike, boat or plane you get into counts the first time, so hop into anything you have not driven before. It builds up naturally as you explore, and you can finish it off in stage 3 by visiting car parks, docks and airfields to find the models you are missing.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 100 vehicles)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when several are in view, and chain the takedowns before it runs out. Gang hideouts and police shootouts are good places to find five targets at once.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA airport: get a plane off the ground without going through the normal departure routine. Steal a plane on the tarmac and take off yourself, and the trophy pops as you leave the airport behind.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no published guide has yet pinned down the exact method for this one. The description points at the Rhino tank: the likely path is getting into a Rhino and surviving the heat it brings, or completing a tank-related challenge. Treat this as a watch item and check the cited guides again before you chase it; do not take any single forum claim as fact until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm, in and out before anyone knows. Plan the approach, keep your head down, and leave clean.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Five separate vault jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. Bring a fast car, know your exit route before you go in, and do not linger once the vault is open.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around the state; stop one, crack it open, take the cash, and get away before the response arrives. One clean job is enough.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which districts you have visited, so sweep the whole state: every city neighbourhood, every swamp town, every beach and back road. The last few are usually the remote corners, so save a dedicated drive for the far edges in stage 3.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 52 areas)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own off-books spots; hit one per gang, nine in total, and keep count in the tracker so you know which gangs are still open.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 9 gangs)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: no combat, no timer, just the right drink in the right place.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side, the way the old games taught us. Pick a showroom with a clear run out and go straight through.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end. Find the alley, pick up a ball, and bowl the whole game; one completed game earns the trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a pedestrian slowly and swing a melee weapon from the car window as you pass. One clean hit earns the trophy; pick a quiet street so you are not fighting the cops straight after.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts to wash them into clean cash. It adds up across the whole game, so keep laundering as you earn and the total will reach $250,000 on its own.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Clothes, weapons, food, car mods: everything you buy counts toward the same pot. You will spend a lot of this naturally on guns and gear, and you can finish it off in stage 3 with a shopping spree once money is no longer tight.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale around Leonida as the story opens the map up; buy each one when you can afford it. They double as storage for the vehicles you collect for Whip It Good, so this pairs well with the vehicle hunt in stage 4.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (PSN count: 8 garages)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one. Any ten count, so use the easiest vehicles you come across and work through the list in stage 4.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
